description: This file defines a service function 'fetchProducts' that fetches product data from a backend API endpoint '/api/products'. It includes fallback logic to return mock product data in case of an error, with optional filtering based on search terms and categories. The function is intended to be used across a frontend application, likely within a React or similar JavaScript framework.

methods.name: fetchProducts(params = {})
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches products from the backend API endpoint '/api/products'. If the request fails, returns mock product data with optional filtering based on provided query parameters 'search' and 'category'.
